objectName: ZephyrCoanda Bladeless Tower Fan & HEPA H13 Air Purifier
designAdjustments: Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Split the 230mm tall Coanda airfoil loop into PRT-07 (Lower 115mm) and PRT-08 (Upper 115mm) with a tongue-and-groove flange so both halves pack flat on a 256×256mm bed.
Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Increased PRT-04 (Impeller Volute) shell thickness to 3.5mm to prevent acoustic panel resonance.
Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Added 42° self-supporting internal roof taper inside PRT-08 upper crown so zero internal support material is trapped inside the air channel.

rounds.summary: Round 1 DFM audit flagged 2 aerodynamic plenum printability issues (internal support removal risk in PRT-08 crown and mid-loop seam leakage). Looping fixes back to Designer.
fixesApplied: PRT-07 / PRT-08: added 0.25mm tongue-and-groove interlocking flange and 42° self-supporting internal crown arch

issues.part: PRT-08 · Coanda Airfoil Loop — Upper Jet-Slot Crown
issues.partName: Coanda Airfoil Loop — Upper Jet-Slot Crown
issues.problem: Flat top internal plenum ceiling would require internal slicer supports that cannot be removed through a 1.5mm nozzle slit.
issues.finding: Internal air duct must be 100% self-supporting without internal support material.
issues.fix: Profile internal plenum ceiling as a 42° gothic teardrop arch.
issues.fixApplied: Converted internal plenum crown to 42° self-supporting teardrop arch (supportsRequired = false).

rounds.summary: Round 2 verification passed (98/100): All 9 printed parts print 100% support-free, fit on 2 Bambu Lab A1 plates, and maintain airtight plenum walls (>=3.0mm).
fixesApplied: Verified all Round 1 aerodynamic & DFM fixes in design.json.
